affinity.description:
Affinity for ClickHouse pods assignment
ref: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/configuration/assign-pod-node/#affinity-and-anti-affinity
NOTE: `podAffinityPreset`, `podAntiAffinityPreset`, and `nodeAffinityPreset` will be ignored when it's set

apiVersions.description: Override Kubernetes API versions reported by .Capabilities

args.description: Override default container args (useful when using custom images)

automountServiceAccountToken.description: Mount Service Account token in pod

command.description: Override default container command (useful when using custom images)

exampleValue.description:
bitnami/common
It is required by CI/CD tools and processes.

commonAnnotations.description: Annotations to add to all deployed objects

commonLabels.description: Labels to add to all deployed objects

configdFiles.description:
Extra configuration files to be mounted at config.d
ref: https://clickhouse.com/docs/operations/configuration-files

configuration.description: Specify content for ClickHouse configuration (basic one auto-generated based on other values otherwise)

customLivenessProbe.description: Custom livenessProbe that overrides the default one

customReadinessProbe.description: Custom readinessProbe that overrides the default one

customStartupProbe.description:
Custom startupProbe that overrides the default one
ClickHouse resource requests and limits
ref: http://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/configuration/manage-compute-resources-container/

diagnosticMode.description: Enable diagnostic mode in the deployment

distributeReplicasByZone.description: Schedules replicas of the same shard to different availability zones

existingConfigdConfigmap.description: The name of an existing ConfigMap with extra configuration files for ClickHouse

existingConfigmap.description: The name of an existing ConfigMap with your custom configuration for ClickHouse

existingUsersdConfigmap.description: The name of an existing ConfigMap with extra users configuration files for ClickHouse

existingUsersdSecret.description: The name of an existing Secret with extra users configuration files for ClickHouse

extraDeploy.description: Array of extra objects to deploy with the release

extraEnvVars.description:
Array with extra environment variables to add to ClickHouse nodes
e.g:
extraEnvVars:
- name: FOO
value: "bar"

extraEnvVarsCM.description: Name of existing ConfigMap containing extra env vars for ClickHouse nodes

extraEnvVarsSecret.description: Name of existing Secret containing extra env vars for ClickHouse nodes

extraVolumeClaimTemplates.description: Optionally specify extra list of additional volumeClaimTemplates for the ClickHouse container(s)

extraVolumeMounts.description: Optionally specify extra list of additional volumeMounts for the ClickHouse container(s)

extraVolumes.description: Optionally specify extra list of additional volumes for the ClickHouse pod(s)

initContainers.description:
Add additional init containers to the ClickHouse pod(s)
ref: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/workloads/pods/init-containers/
e.g:
initContainers:
- name: your-image-name
image: your-image
imagePullPolicy: Always
command: ['sh', '-c', 'echo "hello world"']
Pod Disruption Budget configuration
ref: https://kubernetes.io/docs/tasks/run-application/configure-pdb

initdbScripts.description:
Dictionary of initdb scripts
Specify dictionary of scripts to be run at first boot
Example:
initdbScripts:
my_init_script.sh: |
!/bin/bash
echo "Do something."

initdbScriptsSecret.description: ConfigMap with the initdb scripts (Note: Overrides `initdbScripts`)

enabled.description:
Deploy ClickHouse Keeper to provide coordination capabilities
Bitnami ClickHouse Keeper image
ref: https://hub.docker.com/r/bitnami/clickhouse-keeper/tags/

lifecycleHooks.description: for the ClickHouse container(s) to automate configuration before or after startup

nodeSelector.description:
Node labels for ClickHouse pods assignment
ref: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/scheduling-eviction/assign-pod-node/

persistence.description:
Enable persistence using Persistent Volume Claims
ref: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/storage/persistent-volumes/

podAffinityPreset.description:
Pod affinity preset. Ignored if `affinity` is set. Allowed values: `soft` or `hard`
ref: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/scheduling-eviction/assign-pod-node/#inter-pod-affinity-and-anti-affinity

podAntiAffinityPreset.description:
Pod anti-affinity preset. Ignored if `affinity` is set. Allowed values: `soft` or `hard`
ref: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/scheduling-eviction/assign-pod-node/#inter-pod-affinity-and-anti-affinity

podLabels.description:
Extra labels for ClickHouse pods
ref: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/overview/working-with-objects/labels/

podManagementPolicy.description:
Statefulset Pod management policy, it needs to be Parallel to be able to complete the cluster join
Ref: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/workloads/controllers/statefulset/#pod-management-policies

podSecurityContext.description: If you are using Kubernetes 1.18, the following code needs to be commented out.

replicaCount.description:
Number of ClickHouse replicas per shard to deploy
if keeper enable, same as keeper count, keeper cluster by shards.

resources.description:
Set container requests and limits for different resources like CPU or memory (essential for production workloads)
Example:
resources:
requests:
cpu: 2
memory: 512Mi
limits:
cpu: 3
memory: 1024Mi
Configure Pods Security Context
ref: https://kubernetes.io/docs/tasks/configure-pod-container/security-context/#set-the-security-context-for-a-pod

resourcesPreset.description:
Set container resources according to one common preset (allowed values: none, nano, micro, small, medium, large, xlarge, 2xlarge). This is ignored if resources is set (resources is recommended for production).
More information: https://github.com/bitnami/charts/blob/main/bitnami/common/templates/_resources.tpl#L15

schedulerName.description:
Name of the k8s scheduler (other than default) for ClickHouse pods
ref: https://kubernetes.io/docs/tasks/administer-cluster/configure-multiple-schedulers/

shards.description: Number of ClickHouse shards to deploy

sidecars.description:
Add additional sidecar containers to the ClickHouse pod(s)
e.g:
sidecars:
- name: your-image-name
image: your-image
imagePullPolicy: Always
ports:
- name: portname
containerPort: 1234

startdbScripts.description:
Dictionary of startdb scripts
Specify dictionary of scripts to be run on every start
Example:
startdbScripts:
my_start_script.sh: |
!/bin/bash
echo "Do something."

startdbScriptsSecret.description: ConfigMap with the startdb scripts (Note: Overrides `startdbScripts`)

terminationGracePeriodSeconds.description:
Seconds Redmine pod needs to terminate gracefully
ref: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/workloads/pods/pod/#termination-of-pods

tolerations.description:
Tolerations for ClickHouse pods assignment
ref: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/configuration/taint-and-toleration/

topologySpreadConstraints.description:
Topology Spread Constraints for pod assignment spread across your cluster among failure-domains. Evaluated as a template
Ref: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/workloads/pods/pod-topology-spread-constraints/#spread-constraints-for-pods

usePasswordFiles.description: Mount credentials as files instead of using environment variables

usersdFiles.description:
Extra users configuration files to be mounted at users.d
ref: https://clickhouse.com/docs/operations/configuration-files#user-settings
